source_changes.change: Replace ggml_scale_inplace(state_zero, 0) with ggml_fill_inplace(state_zero, 0) in build_rs. Row selection, state copies, zero-sized no-reset behavior and surrounding graph construction are retained.
Recognize in-place FILL in alias tracking, reset operation classification and recurrent reset metadata; derive reset slot index from byte offset divided by row byte stride.
Translate recurrent cache FILL with literal-value selection over the reset slot range, preserve read-after-reset aliases, and support input dtype and dynamic shape for generic FILL.

Extend the existing rollback regression with 0xff NaN poisoning of discovered recurrent-state buffers. Preserve existing finite all-cache fills. Explicitly mark the NaN case inapplicable when the model declares no recurrent storage; fail if recurrent storage is declared but its buffers cannot be found.

defect.confirmed: Multiplication by zero preserves NaN and can turn infinities into NaN. A recurrent state row cleared this way can remain nonfinite and propagate invalid values through state copies. Literal FILL removes the dependency on previous state values.

cpu.backend: CPU only; HIP, CUDA, Vulkan and OpenVINO disabled in this suite build.

tracked_regression.fixture: Existing recurrent-state rollback test with generated Qwen3.5 model and recurrent-state NaN poisoning.

cases: NaN and positive/negative infinity reset with state copies

The registered shell script returns success despite an unsupported PLaMo3 tokenizer fixture. Direct baseline and candidate checks both fail with unknown tokenizer plamo3.
All 10 available model metadata fixtures pass 33 quantization-type sections each. The hardcoded Nemotron repository returns HTTP 401 and is skipped.

recurrent_coverage.deepseek_v4_nan_case: Explicitly inapplicable because the generated fixture declares no recurrent RS storage; existing finite rollback cases pass.
